name: Santa Goes Digital
author: Addicting Games
description:
Support the Developer!
Check out one of the developer's at https://geminisharon.itch.io/ to support the developer and try out their other games!

 

The digitalization doesn’t stop at Santa's Workshop. In fact, this year, all wish lists have been submitted digitally for the first time. Unfortunately, Santa has only little experience with the digital world.

Give him a hand and help him evaluate this year's submissions.
